# Security

For a vulnerability in a MrewyOrg project, follow that repository's security policy and report it
privately through its Security tab. Project-specific policies take precedence over this shared
guidance.

For this organization profile, shared community files, or repository tooling, use
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/.github/security/advisories/new). Do
not publish exploit details, credentials, or private data in public issues or discussions.

Include the affected repository, version or commit, impact, and a minimal reproduction with secrets
removed. Coordinate public disclosure with the maintainer after a fix is available.

For ordinary bugs and support questions, follow the
[support guide](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/.github/blob/main/.github/SUPPORT.md).

## Preferred Language

English.
